english.note: Use this for notifying someone, especially about an arrangement, decision, or official matter.

exampleSentences.english: The company will inform us that tomorrow’s schedule has changed.
exampleSentences.traditional: 公司會通知我哋聽日改時間。
exampleSentences.jyutping: gung1 si1 wui5 tung1 zi1 ngo5 dei6 ting1 jat6 goi2 si4 gaan3

english.note: Use this when formally notifying someone of information, a risk, or an official decision.

exampleSentences.english: We advise you that classes are cancelled tomorrow.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 tung1 zi1 nei5 ting1 jat6 ting4 fo3
